structure.unit: State Agencies Related to the General Operation of Government

law.catch_line: Baby changing facilities in restrooms located in public buildings
law.text: The Department shall include in the standards established pursuant to subsection B of § 2.2-1132 policies for the construction and installation of physically safe, sanitary, and appropriate baby changing facilities in restrooms. For purposes of this section, "baby changing facility" means a table or other device suitable for changing the diaper of a child age three or younger.
